edit_intro: Saving changes here does not update any device. Push the person again to send the new details.
create_intro: Adds the person to this server only. Push them to a device afterwards, then enrol their face or finger at that terminal.
user_id_hint: The number the terminal knows this person by. Cannot be changed later.
name: Name
name_hint: Optional — a person with no name shows as their PIN.
card_hint: Optional. Leave empty for no card.
privilege_hint: Administrator gives this person the terminal's own menus.
select_prompt: Select an employee to view details
revocation_queued: Revocation queued for {{sn}} — NOT yet confirmed at the door
removed_from: Removed from {{sn}} — the device confirmed it
enroll_started: Enrollment started — ask the person to scan their {{finger}} on the device
delete_template_acc_only: This person is only on access-control terminals, which have no command for deleting one biometric. Remove them from the door instead — that is what removes their templates.
delete_template_needs_device: Employee must be enrolled on at least one device to delete a template
revoked_title_open: Revoked in the system — not yet confirmed at the door
revoked_title_finishing: Revoked — finishing up at the door
revoked_open_body_one: This person can still open the door below. The removal has been queued but the terminal has not collected and confirmed it yet — if it is offline, it will not until it comes back.
revoked_open_body_other: This person can still open the doors below. The removal has been queued but the terminal has not collected and confirmed it yet — if it is offline, it will not until it comes back.
revoked_finishing_body: The terminal has confirmed this person's removal, so they can no longer be recognised there. What is left below is the separate door-permission record being cleared as well.
cancel_revocation: Cancel revocation — let them keep this door
queued_body: Not on the device yet. Each terminal collects one command per poll (about every 10 seconds) and confirms it afterwards.

command_state.pending: Waiting for the device to poll
command_state.sent: Delivered — waiting for the device to confirm

refused.access_not_revoked: ACCESS NOT REVOKED. This terminal never confirmed the removal, so this person may still be able to open this door. Check the device directly.
refused.unreadable_answer: The terminal did answer, with a code this system cannot read — that is not a refusal and not a confirmation.
refused.authorize_not_removed: The terminal did not remove the door permission record. Harmless if the user record itself was removed above — the person is gone either way — but worth checking if it was not.
refused.never_delivered: Never delivered — the server gave up on this command.
refused.unconfirmed: The terminal answered with a code this system cannot read, so this was neither confirmed nor refused — it may have worked. Check the device before assuming either way, or send it again.
refused.door_permission: The door permission was refused. This person can be recognised by the terminal and will still not be let through.
refused.biometric: The terminal refused this biometric. The person is not enrolled at this door and must enrol there in person, or be pushed again.

removal_queued: Removal queued — still open at this door
push_queued_note: This terminal is queued, not written directly: it collects the person and their door permission on its next poll. They appear above once the device confirms, and can enrol a face or finger at the terminal from then on.
nothing_captured: Nothing captured yet. The person enrols a face or finger at a terminal and the device uploads it here by itself.
never_sent_back: A template is never sent back to the terminal that captured it.
bio_queued_note: This terminal is queued, not written: the person and each template are one command per poll, so a face plus a finger is roughly half a minute, and nothing is delivered until the device collects it.
click_finger: Click a finger to see its template, delete it, or enrol it.
biodata_note: Held as a captured biometric (type {{type}}, no {{no}}) — uploaded by a terminal or restored from a ZKTime backup, and listed under Captured Biometrics. No command deletes a single one of those, so there is nothing to offer here.
push_first: Push this person to a device first, then enrol the finger there.
